query: 1. "My Nexa X1 screen goes completely blank, just a dark screen with occasional scrolling and no visible content, so I can't see anything or use Data Transfer to transfer data."

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Blank Screen Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Blank screen fix

steps: Even if you cannot use the touchscreen on your device, access your data with a USB mouse and keyboard.
Connect the mouse and keyboard to your phone or tablet using a USB adapter.
Back up your device's data by connecting it to a monitor.

actions.description: It will rule out hardware damage

steps: If your device displays only a blank or black screen, check the device, charger, and USB cable for damage.

actions.description: It will force the phone to restart

steps: Try forcing a restart by pressing and holding the Power and Volume down buttons for 20 seconds.
Charging the device for at least one hour.
